### Standing Firm in the Storms of Life, Part 1
Author: Mary Southerland
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/standing-firm-in-the-storms-of-life-part-1-girlfriends-in-god-october-22-2013.html
Passage: 2 Corinthians 6:6
Points:
- Difficulties and storms in life are inevitable, but each trial serves as an opportunity to trust God's provision.
- Purity of heart generates supernatural stability and integrity, anchoring believers against collapse when hardship strikes.
- God permits painful seasons to uncover hidden sin, purify character, and instill true spiritual understanding.
- Embracing trials with patience allows God the freedom to mature our faith rather than leave us spiritually underdeveloped.
- Joy during suffering is a deliberate choice grounded in the assurance that God remains sovereign in every crisis.
